messages:
alyssa: Heads-up: proposed RBAC change will remove broad 'secrets:read' from CI role; need to discuss impacts on SAST/DAST artifact access and audit log signing with KMS. Found an open SAST finding in infra repo that relies on decrypting secrets to run a module scan. Details: see sec-bot report below. Thoughts?

marc: Do we have inventory of which CI jobs call KMS decrypt directly vs use secrets manager integration? I can list from infra logs.

jordan: If CI can't decrypt, we can change pipeline to fetch ephemeral tokens from workload identity; avoids giving CI access to KMS keys. But that needs work on agent and might break nightly scans.

tayna: From Sec POV we want least privilege. Prefer ephemeral token flow + sign audit logs via dedicated audit-key with restricted IAM. KMS rotation on schedule.

sec-bot: CI SAST scan failed: HIGH - TF_STATIC_CRED in terraform/modules/aws_vpc/main.tf:12. Evidence: `aws_key = "AKIA..."` Suggested: rotate creds, remove hardcoded, add tfvar from secrets. Link: https://ci.redwood/sec/scan/98321

alyssa: That TF cred was in a forked module copied in last quarter. Someone removed variable interpolation. We should treat as P0, rotate keys immediately. Also DAST produced an "open redirect" in /auth?next= param but triage says false positive due to internal proxy. I'm thinking two parallel actions: 1) immediate key rotation + secret purge; 2) change CI access model so scans don't require decrypt perms. Agree?

marc: I'll open infra PR to add workload identity provider to the scan runners. ETA EOW for draft.

jordan: I'll add a short-term CI exception: allow decrypt on scan-runner key but require MFA + audit events. We need audit signing: can we use HSM-backed KMS key limited to Audit signer? Who owns key policy?

tayna: Security owns the audit key policy. We can grant 'kms:Sign' to logging service account only. No decrypt. That should satisfy compliance.

alyssa: Action items: rotate AWS creds (owner: @tayna), patch TF module (owner: @marc), CI exception & workload-id roadmap (owner: @jordan), update runbook and postmortem. Also need to update SDLC scan gating so codeowners are notified automatically.

oncall-sre: For immediate mitigation I can block the exposed key on firewall and revoke in AWS. Doing now.

marc: PR #412 in infra-org with workload-id changes. notes in PR: uses GCP workload identity; AWS runner TBD.

tayna: I'll update runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sdlc-scan-triage (edited). Add audit log signing checklist.

alyssa: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup: 

sec-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-04-SAST-98321 assigned to tayna. Audit trail will be stored in s3://redwood-compliance/audit/2026/04/1836007890.log (signed by kms-audit-key).
